hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ ! -f .claude/state/current_task.txt ]; then echo "ERROR: No active task. Run /task:select first"; exit 1; fi; echo "=== CURRENT TASK ==="; cat .claude/state/current_task.txt; echo "\n=== PROJECT CONTEXT ==="; cat .claude/cheatsheet.md 2>/dev/null | head -1000; echo "\n=== FEATURE SPECS ==="; cat specs/features/$(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt).md 2>/dev/null | head -2000'

bash -c 'task=$(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$task" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f specs/tests/${task}.test.md ]; then echo "ERROR: No tests found for $task. Tests must be written first!"; exit 1; fi; echo "=== TEST VERIFICATION ==="; stored_hash=$(cat .claude/state/test_hashes/${task}.sha256 2>/dev/null); current_hash=$(sha256sum specs/tests/${task}.test.md | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$stored_hash" != "$current_hash" ] && [ -n "$stored_hash" ]; then echo "ERROR: Test file has been modified! Tests are immutable."; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'echo "=== DEPENDENCY CHECK ==="; if grep -q "mcp_tools:" specs/features/$(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt 2>/dev/null).md 2>/dev/null; then echo "⚠️  This task requires MCP tools. If any tool fails, STOP and notify user."; echo "DO NOT skip or work around missing tools!"; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "npm test" && [ -f .claude/state/performance_baseline.json ]; then echo "=== PERFORMANCE CHECK ==="; echo "Baseline exists. Tests will verify performance does not degrade."; fi'

bash -c 'task=$(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$task" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "=== RUNNING TESTS ==="; npm test -- specs/tests/${task}.test.js 2>&1 | tee .claude/logs/test_results_${task}.log; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ Tests passed!"; echo "0" > .claude/state/failure_count_${task}.txt; else current_count=$(cat .claude/state/failure_count_${task}.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0); new_count=$((current_count + 1)); echo $new_count > .claude/state/failure_count_${task}.txt; echo "❌ Tests failed (attempt $new_count/5)"; if [ $new_count -ge 3 ] && [ $new_count -lt 5 ]; then echo "\n🔍 RESEARCHING DOCUMENTATION..."; cat architecture/*.md specs/*.md | grep -i "${task}" -A 5 -B 5; fi; if [ $new_count -ge 5 ]; then echo "\n🛑 STOPPING: 5 failures reached. Human intervention required."; echo "Task $task failed 5 times. Last error:" >> .claude/logs/failures.log; tail -20 .claude/logs/test_results_${task}.log >> .claude/logs/failures.log; exit 1; fi; fi'
bash -c 'git add -A && git commit -m "WIP: $(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "development")" --no-verify 2>/dev/null || true'

bash -c 'task=$(cat .claude/state/current_task.txt 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$task" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f .claude/logs/test_results_${task}.log ] && grep -q "✅ Tests passed!" .claude/logs/test_results_${task}.log; then echo "=== TASK COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ==="; echo "
📝 Updating registry..."; node .claude/scripts/update-registry.js "$task"; echo "
📚 Updating documentation..."; node .claude/scripts/update-docs.js "$task"; echo "
🧠 Updating memory..."; echo "Task: $task
Status: Completed
Date: $(date)
Implementation: Success" | node .claude/scripts/update-memory.js; echo "
✅ Task $task completed! Marking as done..."; sed -i "s/\[ \] TASK-.*${task}/[x] TASK-.*${task}/g" specs/spec.md; git add -A && git commit -m "feat: Complete $task" --no-verify; echo "
🔄 Next task available:"; grep -m 1 "\[ \] TASK" specs/spec.md || echo "All tasks completed!"; else echo "
⚠️  Task $task not complete. Tests must pass before moving on."; fi'
